chart.title: Would like

intro_examples.text: What would you like? → I'd like a salad, please.
intro_examples.continuation: Use would like to ask for something politely.

rows: We'd like some soup. / Nothing, thanks.
chart.note_rule: Use would like to ask for something politely: I'd like… We'd like…
chart.note_exception: I'd = I would · we'd = we would

rules.title: would like = polite request
rules.jp_title: would like = 丁寧なお願い
rules.subtitle: Use would like to ask for something politely. It is more polite than want.
rules.jp_subtitle: would likeは丁寧にお願いするときに使います。wantより丁寧です。

examples.jp: サラダをいただきたいです。
スープをいただきたいです。

rules.title: I'd = I would
rules.subtitle: I'd is the contraction of I would. Use it before like.
rules.jp_subtitle: I'dはI wouldの短縮形です。likeの前に置きます。

examples.jp: サラダをいただきたいです。

examples.text: I'd like a pumpkin pie, please.
examples.jp: かぼちゃパイをいただきたいです。

rules.title: we'd = we would
rules.subtitle: We'd is the contraction of we would. Use it before like.
rules.jp_subtitle: We'dはwe wouldの短縮形です。likeの前に置きます。

examples.jp: スープをいただきたいです。

examples.text: We'd like some vegetables from the garden.
examples.jp: 庭の野菜をいただきたいです。

rules.title: What would you like?
rules.subtitle: Use What would you like? to ask what someone wants politely.
rules.jp_subtitle: What would you like?は相手が何を望むかを丁寧に尋ねます。

transforms.to: What would you like for lunch? / to drink?

examples.jp: 昼食に何を召し上がりますか？

rules.title: Would you like…? → Yes, please. / No, thanks.
rules.jp_title: Would you like…? → Yes, please. / No, thanks.
rules.subtitle: Use Would you like…? to offer something. Answer with Yes, please or No, thanks.
rules.jp_subtitle: Would you like…?で何かを勧めます。Yes, pleaseかNo, thanksで答えます。

examples.jp: ジュースはいかがですか？→ はい、ぜひ。

examples.text: Would you like a cucumber in your salad? → No, thanks.
examples.jp: サラダにきゅうりを入れたいですか？→ いいえ、けっこうです。

explanation.title: I'd
explanation.body: I'd is the contraction of I would. I'd like = I would like.

questions.jp: サラダをいただきたいです。

explanation.title: would
explanation.body: Use would to ask politely: What would you like?

questions.jp: 昼食に何を召し上がりますか？
スープをいただきたいです。

explanation.title: Would
explanation.body: Use Would you like…? to offer something politely.

questions.jp: ジュースはいかがですか？

explanation.title: Yes, please.
explanation.body: The polite answer to Would you like…? is Yes, please or No, thanks.

questions.jp: ジュースはいかがですか？→ はい、ぜひ。

explanation.title: I would
explanation.body: I'd is the short form of I would.

questions.jp: I'dは何の短縮形ですか？

explanation.title: I'd like
explanation.body: I'd like is the polite way to request something.

questions.jp: どれが最も丁寧ですか？

explanation.title: to drink
explanation.body: After would like, use the infinitive: to drink.

questions.jp: 何を飲みたいですか？

explanation.title: we would
explanation.body: We'd is the short form of we would.

questions.jp: We'dは何の短縮形ですか？

explanation.title: I'd like
explanation.body: After would, always use the base form: like (not likes/liking/liked).
